title: Thi Baali Sakina Ki Fugaa Baadile Muztar Baba Ho
body:
Thi Baali Sakina Ki Fugaa Baadile Muztar Baba Ho
<<MINI>>
kaha Par
<<DIVIDER>>
kia Haal Huwa Mera Yaha Dekho To Aakar Baba Ho
<<MINI>>
kaha Par
<<DIVIDER>>
01. Har Gaam Pe Dekho Hai Qayamat Ki Musibat
durro Ki Aziyyat
zanjeer Me Jakda Hua Hai Mera Baradar Baba Ho
<<MINI>>
kaha Par
<<DIVIDER>>
02. Ammu Bhi Gaye Paani Ko Laute Nahi Ab Tak
pyasi Rahu Kab Tak
dikhlaake Mujhe Paani Bahata Hai Sitagar Baba Ho
<<MINI>>
kaha Par
<<DIVIDER>>
03. Mai Aapki Furqat Me Agar Roi To Baba
di Shimr Ne Eeza
pursa Mujhe Deta Hai Tamache Wo Laga Kar Baba
<<MINI>>
ho Kaha Par
<<DIVIDER>>
04. Naize Ki Ani Se Use Zaalim Ne Hai Khaicha
ye Zulm Hai Kaisa
cheene Gaye Bedardi Se In Kaano Se Gauhar Baba Ho
<<MINI>>
kaha Par
<<DIVIDER>>
05.zaalim Ne Muqayyad Kiya Zindaan Me Mujhko
kia Zulm Hai Dekho
is Ghor Andhere Me Mera Jeena Hai Dou Bhar Baba
<<MINI>>
ho Kaha Par
<<DIVIDER>>
06. Aajaye Baba Mujhe Zaalim Se Bachane
zindaan Se Chudane
yeh Kehte Huwe Margai Shabbir Ki Dukhtar Baba Ho
<<MINI>>
kaha Par
<<DIVIDER>>
07.dekho Fasi Kaisi Hai Sakina Ki Ye Ghurbat
zindaan Me Turbat
aayegi Sada Ab Bhi Tumhe Rauze Ke Andar Baba Ho
<<MINI>>
kaha Par
